samples.summary: Removal of `clearCopyBuffer()` from the two view paste handlers is not exercised by any test
samples.evidence: The diff deletes `this.sheet!.clearCopyBuffer()` in `view/worksheet.ts` (~4941) and `view/spreadsheet.ts` (~724) — the behavior the task doc calls out as the round-1 fix (repeat paste keeps relocation/merges; a refused paste keeps the clipboard). The new test `should propagate merges on a second paste from the same copy` (test/sheet/merge.test.ts:~800+) and `should keep the copy buffer when a paste is refused` call `sheet.paste(...)` directly on the model, so they pass identically whether or not the view still clears the buffer; their comments ('the view no longer drops the buffer after the first') claim coverage the tests do not provide. The only view-level paste test, test/view/worksheet-keymap.test.ts:22,59, mocks `paste` with `vi.fn()` and asserts nothing about the copy buffer, so the view handler logic is fully mocked away.

samples.summary: New spill-blocker plumbing on the paste path (`unblockedAnchors`, spill-ghost cleanup inside `clearCellsUnderMerge`) has no test
samples.evidence: `paste` now threads `unblockedAnchors` through `applyPasteMerges` and widens the recalculation condition to `changedSrefs.size > 0 || unblockedAnchors.size > 0`, seeding previously-blocked anchors into `expanded`/`dependantsMap`; `clearCellsUnderMerge` deletes spill ghosts and calls `clearSpillBlockers`/`consumeSpillBlocker`. No test in the new `Sheet merge + copy-paste` block (test/sheet/merge.test.ts:344-857) involves a spill formula; `grep -i spill packages/sheets/test` matches only worksheet-grid, calculation, data-validation, formatting, style-mutation and formula tests — none of which paste over a merge. Failure mode (orphaned ghost cells or a formula that never re-spills after the blocker is cleared) is silently wrong data.

samples.summary: `crossesFreezePane` frozen-COLUMN branch is untested on every caller
samples.evidence: `crossesFreezePane` handles rows and columns, and is now used by `planPasteMerges`, `moveRangeTo` and the refactored `canMergeSelection`. Both new freeze tests (merge.test.ts:621 paste, merge.test.ts:690 move) use `setFreezePane(2, 0)` — frozen rows only. Grepping the whole sheets test tree for `canMergeSelection` finds only pivot-protection.test.ts:132 (a pivot guard), so the extraction of the frozen-row/col condition out of `canMergeSelection` also has no behavioral test. A broken column branch would let a straddling merged block be created/moved/pasted, which the renderer cannot draw.

samples.summary: Merge deletion is asserted only in the in-memory map, never against the store
samples.evidence: `applyPasteMerges` calls `await this.store.deleteMerge(...)` alongside `this.merges.delete(...)`. Only the creation side is verified against the store (`should persist the pasted merge to the store`, merge.test.ts:~360, checks `store.getMerges().get('A3')`). The drop cases — `should drop a cut merged block at the source` and `should drop a destination block the paste fully covers` — assert only `sheet.getMerges()`, so a missing/failed `store.deleteMerge` would pass while the merge resurrects on reload.

samples.evidence: `snapshotMergesIn` filters copied merges with `isRangeInRange(m.range, range)` so a block the copy range only clips is not recorded (and therefore not re-created at the destination). No test in the new `Sheet merge + copy-paste` block constructs a selection that clips a merged block (the helper's own doc says the UI cannot reach it, but `copy`/`cut` are public API). If the filter were inverted/dropped, a paste would materialize a block that was never fully copied.

samples.summary: New refusal messages (`merge-paste-partial`, `merge-paste-frozen`, `merge-move-frozen`) have no test
samples.evidence: `refusalMessage` gains three cases in view/worksheet.ts:107-116. The model tests assert the refusal *codes* via `setOnRefusal`, but nothing asserts the user-visible strings or that `refusalMessage` handles the new union members (the exhaustive switch is compile-checked by tsc, so the risk is only wording/routing).

The new `rangeOf` tests cover a normal grid and a 200k-cell grid. The empty-grid case (returns Infinity/-Infinity bounds, same as before) is untested; the task doc at docs/tasks/active/20260912-sheets-paste-merge-propagation-todo.md:123 explicitly lists it as 'not taken'. Low impact since `selectPastedRange` guards on `grid.size === 0`, but a future caller has no pinned contract.
